requirements.statement: The primary user can complete the critical task.

acceptance.check: Run critical journey JRN-001 from a clean state.
acceptance.expected: The user reaches the declared success state without an undocumented workaround.

critical_journeys.success: The intended result is visible and persisted.
critical_journeys.failure_and_recovery: A failed action explains what happened and offers a valid recovery path.
critical_journeys.verification: Browser or equivalent live end-to-end test.
